search_text: published ZDI-24-468 ZDI-CAN-21579 Sante PACS Server PG Patient Query SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2024-05-17 CVE-2023-51637 https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2023-51637 9.8 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H ['Sante'] ['PACS Server PG'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Sante PACS Server PG. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the DICOM service, which listens on TCP port 11122 by default. When parsing the NAME element of the PATIENT record, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of NETWORK SERVICE. Fixed in version 3.3.7 https://www.santesoft.com/win/sante-pacs-server-pg/whats_new.html ['2023-11-28 - Vulnerability reported to vendor', '2024-05-17 - Coordinated public release of advisory', '2024-07-01 - Advisory Updated'] Guillaume CHANTREL, Florent Saudel https://www.zerodayinitiative.com/advisories/ZDI-24-468/
title: Sante PACS Server PG Patient Query SQL Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of Sante PACS Server PG. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the DICOM service, which listens on TCP port 11122 by default. When parsing the NAME element of the PATIENT record, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of NETWORK SERVICE.
